68#define SAFE_GETSTACK(VariableName, IgnoreCount, MaxDepth) \
69 TArray<FProgramCounterSymbolInfo> VariableName = FPlatformStackWalk::GetStack(IgnoreCount, MaxDepth); \
70 if (VariableName.Num() == 0) \
71 { \
72 /* This is a rare failure that can occur in some circumstances */ \
73 FProgramCounterSymbolInfo& Info = VariableName.Emplace_GetRef(); \
74 TCString<ANSICHAR>::Strncpy(Info.Filename, "Unknown", FProgramCounterSymbolInfo::MAX_NAME_LENGTH); \
75 Info.LineNumber = 1; \
76 }

88enum class EAutomationTestFlags
89{
90 None = 0x00000000,
91 //~ Application context required for the test
92 // Test is suitable for running within the editor
93 EditorContext = 0x00000001,
94 // Test is suitable for running within the client
95 ClientContext = 0x00000002,
96 // Test is suitable for running within the server
97 ServerContext = 0x00000004,
98 // Test is suitable for running within a commandlet
99 CommandletContext = 0x00000008,
100 // Test is suitable for running within program application (not editor, nor game)
101 ProgramContext = 0x00000010,
102
103 //~ Features required for the test - not specifying means it is valid for any feature combination
104 // Test requires a non-null RHI to run correctly
105 NonNullRHI = 0x00000100,
106 // Test requires a user instigated session
107 RequiresUser = 0x00000200,
108
109 //~ One-off flags
110 // Fast disable: turns off a test without commenting code out. Never returns for a filter.
111 Disabled = 0x00010000,
112
113 // When AutoRTFM is enabled, the test will be executed within a transaction that commits,
114 // and within another transaction that aborts. (The test will also execute non-transactionally.)
115 SupportsAutoRTFM = 0x00020000,
116
117 //~ Priority of the test
118 // The highest priority possible. Showstopper/blocker.
119 CriticalPriority = 0x00100000,
120 // High priority. Major feature functionality etc.
121 HighPriority = 0x00200000,
122 // Medium Priority. Minor feature functionality, major generic content issues.
123 MediumPriority = 0x00400000,
124 // Low Priority. Minor content bugs. String errors. Etc.
125 LowPriority = 0x00800000,
126
127 //~ Speed of the test
128 //Super Fast Filter
129 SmokeFilter = 0x01000000,
130 //Engine Level Test
131 EngineFilter = 0x02000000,
132 //Product Level Test
133 ProductFilter = 0x04000000,
134 //Performance Test
135 PerfFilter = 0x08000000,
136 //Stress Test
137 StressFilter = 0x10000000,
138 //Negative Test. For tests whose correct expected outcome is failure.
139 NegativeFilter = 0x20000000,
140};

627struct FAutomationExpectedMessage
628{
629 // Original string pattern matching expected log message.
630 // If IsRegex is false, it is this string that is used to match.
631 // Otherwise MessagePatternRegex is set to a valid pointer of FRegexPattern.
632 // The base pattern string is preserved none the less to allow checks for duplicate entries.
633 FString MessagePatternString;
634 // Regular expression pattern from MessagePatternString if regex option was true(default), otherwise it is not set.
635 TOptional<FRegexPattern> MessagePatternRegex;
636 // Type of comparison to perform on error log using MessagePattern.
637 EAutomationExpectedMessageFlags::MatchType CompareType;
643 int32 ExpectedNumberOfOccurrences;
644 int32 ActualNumberOfOccurrences;
645 // Log message Verbosity
646 ELogVerbosity::Type Verbosity;
647
651 FAutomationExpectedMessage(FString& InMessagePattern, ELogVerbosity::Type InVerbosity, EAutomationExpectedMessageFlags::MatchType InCompareType, int32 InExpectedNumberOfOccurrences = 1, bool IsRegex = true)
652 : MessagePatternString(InMessagePattern)
653 , CompareType(InCompareType)
654 , ExpectedNumberOfOccurrences(InExpectedNumberOfOccurrences)
655 , ActualNumberOfOccurrences(0)
656 , Verbosity(InVerbosity)
657 {
658 if (IsRegex)
659 {
660 MessagePatternRegex = FRegexPattern((InCompareType == EAutomationExpectedMessageFlags::Exact) ? FString::Printf(TEXT("^%s$"), *InMessagePattern) : InMessagePattern, ERegexPatternFlags::CaseInsensitive);
661 }
662 }
663
664 FAutomationExpectedMessage(FString& InMessagePattern, ELogVerbosity::Type InVerbosity, int32 InExpectedNumberOfOccurrences)
665 : MessagePatternString(InMessagePattern)
666 , MessagePatternRegex(FRegexPattern(InMessagePattern, ERegexPatternFlags::CaseInsensitive))
667 , CompareType(EAutomationExpectedMessageFlags::Contains)
668 , ExpectedNumberOfOccurrences(InExpectedNumberOfOccurrences)
669 , ActualNumberOfOccurrences(0)
670 , Verbosity(InVerbosity)
671 {}
672
673 inline bool IsRegex() const
674 {
675 return MessagePatternRegex.IsSet();
676 }
677
678 inline bool IsExactCompareType() const
679 {
680 return CompareType == EAutomationExpectedMessageFlags::Exact;
681 }
682
688 bool Matches(const FString& Message)
689 {
690 bool HasMatch = false;
691 if (IsRegex())
692 {
693 FRegexMatcher MessageMatcher(MessagePatternRegex.GetValue(), Message);
694 HasMatch = MessageMatcher.FindNext();
695 }
696 else
697 {
698 HasMatch = Message.Contains(MessagePatternString) && (!IsExactCompareType() || Message.Len() == MessagePatternString.Len());
699 }
700 ActualNumberOfOccurrences += HasMatch;
701 return HasMatch;
702 }
703
704 bool operator==(const FAutomationExpectedMessage& Other) const
705 {
706 return MessagePatternString == Other.MessagePatternString;
707 }
708
709 bool operator<(const FAutomationExpectedMessage& Other) const
710 {
711 return MessagePatternString < Other.MessagePatternString;
712 }
713
714};
715
716UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT uint32 GetTypeHash(const FAutomationExpectedMessage& Object)
717{
718 return GetTypeHash(Object.MessagePatternString);
719}

865{
866 Zero,
867 Low,
868 Medium,
869 High
870};

872struct FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount
873{
874public:
875
876 FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount()
877 : Red(0)
878 , Green(0)
879 , Blue(0)
880 , Alpha(0)
881 , MinBrightness(0)
882 , MaxBrightness(255)
883 {
884 }
885
886 FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount(uint8 R, uint8 G, uint8 B, uint8 A, uint8 InMinBrightness, uint8 InMaxBrightness)
887 : Red(R)
888 , Green(G)
889 , Blue(B)
890 , Alpha(A)
891 , MinBrightness(InMinBrightness)
892 , MaxBrightness(InMaxBrightness)
893 {
894 }
895
896 static FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount FromToleranceLevel(EAutomationComparisonToleranceLevel InTolerance)
897 {
898 switch (InTolerance)
899 {
900 case EAutomationComparisonToleranceLevel::Low:
901 return FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount(16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 240);
902 case EAutomationComparisonToleranceLevel::Medium:
903 return FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount(24, 24, 24, 24, 24, 220);
904 case EAutomationComparisonToleranceLevel::High:
905 return FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount(32, 32, 32, 32, 64, 96);
906 }
907 // Zero
908 return FAutomationComparisonToleranceAmount(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 255);
909 }
910
911 uint8 Red;
912 uint8 Green;
913 uint8 Blue;
914 uint8 Alpha;
915 uint8 MinBrightness;
916 uint8 MaxBrightness;
917};

1555class FAutomationTestTags
1556{
1557public:
1565 FAutomationTestTags(const FString& InTestFullName, const FString& InTags)
1566 {
1567 LLM_SCOPE_BYNAME(TEXT("AutomationTest/Framework"));
1568 TestFullName = InTestFullName;
1569 bool Registered = FAutomationTestFramework::Get().RegisterAutomationTestTags( InTestFullName, InTags );
1570 if (!Registered)
1571 {
1572 UE_LOGF(LogAutomationTestFramework, Warning, "Tag registration already exists for test '%ls', existing value was not overridden", *TestFullName);
1573 }
1574 }
1575
1579 FAutomationTestTags() {}
1580
1581 ~FAutomationTestTags()
1582 {
1583 if (!TestFullName.IsEmpty())
1584 {
1585 //ignore failure to unregister due to already being unregistered
1586 FAutomationTestFramework::Get().UnregisterAutomationTestTags(TestFullName);
1587 }
1588 }
1589private:
1590 FString TestFullName;
1591};

2715class FBDDAutomationTestBase : public FAutomationTestBase
2716{
2717public:
2718 FBDDAutomationTestBase(const FString& InName, const bool bInComplexTask)
2719 : FAutomationTestBase(InName, bInComplexTask)
2720 , bIsDiscoveryMode(false)
2721 , bBaseRunTestRan(false)
2722 {}
2723
2724 virtual bool RunTest(const FString& Parameters) override
2725 {
2726 bBaseRunTestRan = true;
2727 TestIdToExecute = Parameters;
2728
2729 return true;
2730 }
2731
2732 virtual void GetTests(TArray<FString>& OutBeautifiedNames, TArray <FString>& OutTestCommands) const override
2733 {
2734 const_cast<FBDDAutomationTestBase*>(this)->BeautifiedNames.Empty();
2735 const_cast<FBDDAutomationTestBase*>(this)->TestCommands.Empty();
2736
2737 bIsDiscoveryMode = true;
2738 const_cast<FBDDAutomationTestBase*>(this)->RunTest(FString());
2739 bIsDiscoveryMode = false;
2740
2741 OutBeautifiedNames.Append(BeautifiedNames);
2742 OutTestCommands.Append(TestCommands);
2743 bBaseRunTestRan = false;
2744 }
2745
2746 bool IsDiscoveryMode() const
2747 {
2748 return bIsDiscoveryMode;
2749 }
2750
2751 void xDescribe(const FString& InDescription, TFunction<void()> DoWork)
2752 {
2753 check(bBaseRunTestRan);
2754 //disabled this suite
2755 }
2756
2757 void Describe(const FString& InDescription, TFunction<void()> DoWork)
2758 {
2759 check(bBaseRunTestRan);
2760
2761 PushDescription(InDescription);
2762
2763 int32 OriginalBeforeEachCount = BeforeEachStack.Num();
2764 int32 OriginalAfterEachCount = AfterEachStack.Num();
2765
2766 DoWork();
2767
2768 check(OriginalBeforeEachCount <= BeforeEachStack.Num());
2769 if (OriginalBeforeEachCount != BeforeEachStack.Num())
2770 {
2771 BeforeEachStack.Pop();
2772 }
2773
2774 check(OriginalAfterEachCount <= AfterEachStack.Num());
2775 if (OriginalAfterEachCount != AfterEachStack.Num())
2776 {
2777 AfterEachStack.Pop();
2778 }
2779
2780 PopDescription(InDescription);
2781 }
2782
2783 void xIt(const FString& InDescription, TFunction<void()> DoWork)
2784 {
2785 check(bBaseRunTestRan);
2786 //disabled this spec
2787 }
2788
2789 void It(const FString& InDescription, TFunction<void()> DoWork)
2790 {
2791 check(bBaseRunTestRan);
2792
2793 PushDescription(InDescription);
2794
2795 if (bIsDiscoveryMode)
2796 {
2797 BeautifiedNames.Add(GetDescription());
2798
2799 bIsDiscoveryMode = false;
2800 TestCommands.Add(GetDescription());
2801 bIsDiscoveryMode = true;
2802 }
2803 else if (TestIdToExecute.IsEmpty() || GetDescription() == TestIdToExecute)
2804 {
2805 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < BeforeEachStack.Num(); Index++)
2806 {
2807 BeforeEachStack[Index]();
2808 }
2809
2810 DoWork();
2811
2812 for (int32 Index = AfterEachStack.Num() - 1; Index >= 0; Index--)
2813 {
2814 AfterEachStack[Index]();
2815 }
2816 }
2817
2818 PopDescription(InDescription);
2819 }
2820
2821 void BeforeEach(TFunction<void()> DoWork)
2822 {
2823 BeforeEachStack.Push(DoWork);
2824 }
2825
2826 void AfterEach(TFunction<void()> DoWork)
2827 {
2828 AfterEachStack.Push(DoWork);
2829 }
2830
2831private:
2832
2833 void PushDescription(const FString& InDescription)
2834 {
2835 Description.Add(InDescription);
2836 }
2837
2838 void PopDescription(const FString& InDescription)
2839 {
2840 Description.RemoveAt(Description.Num() - 1);
2841 }
2842
2843 FString GetDescription() const
2844 {
2845 FString CompleteDescription;
2846 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Description.Num(); ++Index)
2847 {
2848 if (Description[Index].IsEmpty())
2849 {
2850 continue;
2851 }
2852
2853 if (CompleteDescription.IsEmpty())
2854 {
2855 CompleteDescription = Description[Index];
2856 }
2857 else if (FChar::IsWhitespace(CompleteDescription[CompleteDescription.Len() - 1]) || FChar::IsWhitespace(Description[Index][0]))
2858 {
2859 if (bIsDiscoveryMode)
2860 {
2861 CompleteDescription = CompleteDescription + TEXT(".") + Description[Index];
2862 }
2863 else
2864 {
2865 CompleteDescription = CompleteDescription + Description[Index];
2866 }
2867 }
2868 else
2869 {
2870 if (bIsDiscoveryMode)
2871 {
2872 CompleteDescription = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s.%s"), *CompleteDescription, *Description[Index]);
2873 }
2874 else
2875 {
2876 CompleteDescription = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s %s"), *CompleteDescription, *Description[Index]);
2877 }
2878 }
2879 }
2880
2881 return CompleteDescription;
2882 }
2883
2884private:
2885
2886 FString TestIdToExecute;
2887 TArray<FString> Description;
2888 TArray<TFunction<void()>> BeforeEachStack;
2889 TArray<TFunction<void()>> AfterEachStack;
2890
2891 TArray<FString> BeautifiedNames;
2892 TArray<FString> TestCommands;
2893 mutable bool bIsDiscoveryMode;
2894 mutable bool bBaseRunTestRan;
2895};

2914 virtual ~FSingleExecuteLatentCommand() = default;
2915
2916 virtual bool Update() override
2917 {
2918 if (bSkipIfErrored && Spec->HasAnyErrors())
2919 {
2920 return true;
2921 }
2922
2923 Predicate();
2924 return true;
2925 }
2926
2927 private:
2928
2929 const FAutomationSpecBase* const Spec;
2930 const TFunction<void()> Predicate;
2931 const bool bSkipIfErrored;
2932 };
2933
2934 class FUntilDoneLatentCommand : public IAutomationLatentCommand
2935 {
2936 public:
2937
2938 FUntilDoneLatentCommand(FAutomationSpecBase* const InSpec, TFunction<void(const FDoneDelegate&)> InPredicate, const FTimespan& InTimeout, bool bInSkipIfErrored = false)
2939 : Spec(InSpec)
2940 , Predicate(MoveTemp(InPredicate))
2941 , Timeout(InTimeout)
2942 , bSkipIfErrored(bInSkipIfErrored)
2943 , bIsRunning(false)
2944 , bDone(false)
2945 { }
2946
2947 virtual ~FUntilDoneLatentCommand() = default;
2948
2949 virtual bool Update() override
2950 {
2951 if (!bIsRunning)
2952 {
2953 if (bSkipIfErrored && Spec->HasAnyErrors())
2954 {
2955 return true;
2956 }
2957
2958 bDone = false;
2959 bIsRunning = true;
2960 StartedRunning = FDateTime::UtcNow();
2961 Predicate(FDoneDelegate::CreateSP(this, &FUntilDoneLatentCommand::Done));
2962 }
2963
2964 if (bDone)
2965 {
2966 Reset();
2967 return true;
2968 }
2969 else if ((FDateTime::UtcNow() >= StartedRunning + Timeout) && !FPlatformMisc::IsDebuggerPresent())
2970 {
2971 Reset();
2972 Spec->AddError(TEXT("Latent command timed out."), 0);
2973 return true;
2974 }
2975
2976 return false;
2977 }
2978
2979 private:
2980
2981 void Done()
2982 {
2983 if (bIsRunning)
2984 {
2985 bDone = true;
2986 }
2987 }
2988
2989 void Reset()
2990 {
2991 // Reset the done for the next potential run of this command
2992 bDone = false;
2993 bIsRunning = false;
2994 }
2995
2996 private:
2997
2998 FAutomationSpecBase* const Spec;
2999 const TFunction<void(const FDoneDelegate&)> Predicate;
3000 const FTimespan Timeout;
3001 const bool bSkipIfErrored;
3002
3003 bool bIsRunning;
3004 FDateTime StartedRunning;
3005 FThreadSafeBool bDone;
3006 };
3007

3023 virtual bool Update() override
3024 {

3031

3038 });

3041 if (bDone)

3054 }
3055
3056 private:

3058 void Done()

3062 {
3063 bDone = true;
3064 }
3065 }
3066
3067 void Reset()
3068 {

3070 // Reset the done for the next potential run of this command

3072 Future.Reset();
3073 }
3074
3075 private:
3076
3077 FAutomationSpecBase* const Spec;
3078 const EAsyncExecution Execution;
3079 const TFunction<void(const FDoneDelegate&)> Predicate;

3081 const bool bSkipIfErrored;
3082
3083 FThreadSafeBool bDone;

3216 FAutomationSpecBase(const FString& InName, const bool bInComplexTask)
3217 : FAutomationTestBase(InName, bInComplexTask)

3226 virtual bool RunTest(const FString& InParameters) override
3227 {
3228 EnsureDefinitions();
3229
3230 if (!InParameters.IsEmpty())
3231 {
3232 const TSharedRef<FSpec>* SpecToRun = IdToSpecMap.Find(InParameters);
3233 if (SpecToRun != nullptr)
3234 {
3235 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < (*SpecToRun)->Commands.Num(); ++Index)
3236 {
3237 FAutomationTestFramework::GetInstance().EnqueueLatentCommand((*SpecToRun)->Commands[Index]);
3238 }
3239 }
3240 }
3241 else
3242 {
3243 TArray<TSharedRef<FSpec>> Specs;
3244 IdToSpecMap.GenerateValueArray(Specs);
3245
3246 for (int32 SpecIndex = 0; SpecIndex < Specs.Num(); SpecIndex++)
3247 {
3248 for (int32 CommandIndex = 0; CommandIndex < Specs[SpecIndex]->Commands.Num(); ++CommandIndex)
3249 {
3250 FAutomationTestFramework::GetInstance().EnqueueLatentCommand(Specs[SpecIndex]->Commands[CommandIndex]);
3251 }
3252 }
3253 }
3254
3255 return true;
3256 }

3268 virtual FString GetTestSourceFileName(const FString& InTestName) const override

3271 if (TestId.StartsWith(TestName + TEXT(" ")))
3272 {
3273 TestId = InTestName.RightChop(TestName.Len() + 1);
3274 }
3275
3276 const TSharedRef<FSpec>* Spec = IdToSpecMap.Find(TestId);
3277 if (Spec != nullptr)
3278 {
3279 return (*Spec)->Filename;
3280 }
3281
3282 return FAutomationTestBase::GetTestSourceFileName();
3283 }

3325
3326 void Describe(const TArray<FString> InDescriptions, TFunction<void(int32 /*Iteration*/)> DoWork)
3327 {
3328 LLM_SCOPE_BYNAME(TEXT("AutomationTest/Framework"));
3329
3330 for (int32 It = 0; It < InDescriptions.Num(); ++It)
3331 {
3332 const TSharedRef<FSpecDefinitionScope> ParentScope = DefinitionScopeStack.Last();
3333 const TSharedRef<FSpecDefinitionScope> NewScope = MakeShareable(new FSpecDefinitionScope());
3334 NewScope->Description = InDescriptions[It];
3335 ParentScope->Children.Push(NewScope);
3336
3337 DefinitionScopeStack.Push(NewScope);
3338 PushDescription(InDescriptions[It]);
3339 DoWork(It);
3340 PopDescription(InDescriptions[It]);
3341 DefinitionScopeStack.Pop();
3342
3343 if (NewScope->It.Num() == 0 && NewScope->Children.Num() == 0)
3344 {
3345 ParentScope->Children.Remove(NewScope);
3346 }
3347 }
3348 }

3607protected:
3608
3609 /* The timespan for how long a block should be allowed to execute before giving up and failing the test */
3610 FTimespan DefaultTimeout;
3611
3612 /* Whether or not BeforeEach and It blocks should skip execution if the test has already failed */
3613 bool bEnableSkipIfError;
3614
3615 void EnsureDefinitions() const
3616 {
3617 if (!bHasBeenDefined)
3618 {
3619 const_cast<FAutomationSpecBase*>(this)->Define();
3620 const_cast<FAutomationSpecBase*>(this)->PostDefine();
3621 }
3622 }
3623
3624 virtual void Define() = 0;
3625
3626 void PostDefine()
3627 {
3628 TArray<TSharedRef<FSpecDefinitionScope>> Stack;
3629 Stack.Push(RootDefinitionScope.ToSharedRef());
3630
3631 TArray<TSharedRef<IAutomationLatentCommand>> BeforeEach;
3632 TArray<TSharedRef<IAutomationLatentCommand>> AfterEach;
3633
3634 while (Stack.Num() > 0)
3635 {
3636 const TSharedRef<FSpecDefinitionScope> Scope = Stack.Last();
3637
3638 BeforeEach.Append(Scope->BeforeEach);
3639 AfterEach.Append(Scope->AfterEach); // iterate in reverse
3640
3641 for (int32 ItIndex = 0; ItIndex < Scope->It.Num(); ItIndex++)
3642 {
3643 TSharedRef<FSpecIt> It = Scope->It[ItIndex];
3644
3645 TSharedRef<FSpec> Spec = MakeShareable(new FSpec());
3646 Spec->Id = It->Id;
3647 Spec->Description = It->Description;
3648 Spec->Filename = It->Filename;
3649 Spec->LineNumber = It->LineNumber;
3650 Spec->Commands.Append(BeforeEach);
3651 Spec->Commands.Add(It->Command);
3652
3653 for (int32 AfterEachIndex = AfterEach.Num() - 1; AfterEachIndex >= 0; AfterEachIndex--)
3654 {
3655 Spec->Commands.Add(AfterEach[AfterEachIndex]);
3656 }
3657
3658 check(!IdToSpecMap.Contains(Spec->Id));
3659 IdToSpecMap.Add(Spec->Id, Spec);
3660 }
3661 Scope->It.Empty();
3662
3663 if (Scope->Children.Num() > 0)
3664 {
3665 Stack.Append(Scope->Children);
3666 Scope->Children.Empty();
3667 }
3668 else
3669 {
3670 while (Stack.Num() > 0 && Stack.Last()->Children.Num() == 0 && Stack.Last()->It.Num() == 0)
3671 {
3672 const TSharedRef<FSpecDefinitionScope> PoppedScope = Stack.Pop();
3673
3674 if (PoppedScope->BeforeEach.Num() > 0)
3675 {
3676 BeforeEach.RemoveAt(BeforeEach.Num() - PoppedScope->BeforeEach.Num(), PoppedScope->BeforeEach.Num());
3677 }
3678
3679 if (PoppedScope->AfterEach.Num() > 0)
3680 {
3681 AfterEach.RemoveAt(AfterEach.Num() - PoppedScope->AfterEach.Num(), PoppedScope->AfterEach.Num());
3682 }
3683 }
3684 }
3685 }
3686
3687 RootDefinitionScope.Reset();
3688 DefinitionScopeStack.Reset();
3689 bHasBeenDefined = true;
3690 }
3691
3692 void Redefine()
3693 {
3694 Description.Empty();
3695 IdToSpecMap.Empty();
3696 RootDefinitionScope.Reset();
3697 DefinitionScopeStack.Empty();
3698 bHasBeenDefined = false;
3699
3700 RootDefinitionScope = MakeShareable(new FSpecDefinitionScope());
3701 DefinitionScopeStack.Push(RootDefinitionScope.ToSharedRef());
3702 }
3703
3704private:
3705
3706 void PushDescription(const FString& InDescription)
3707 {
3708 LLM_SCOPE_BYNAME(TEXT("AutomationTest/Framework"));
3709 Description.Add(InDescription);
3710 }
3711
3712 void PopDescription(const FString& InDescription)
3713 {
3714 Description.RemoveAt(Description.Num() - 1);
3715 }
3716
3717 FString GetDescription() const
3718 {
3719 FString CompleteDescription;
3720 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Description.Num(); ++Index)
3721 {
3722 if (Description[Index].IsEmpty())
3723 {
3724 continue;
3725 }
3726
3727 if (CompleteDescription.IsEmpty())
3728 {
3729 CompleteDescription = Description[Index];
3730 }
3731 else if (FChar::IsWhitespace(CompleteDescription[CompleteDescription.Len() - 1]) || FChar::IsWhitespace(Description[Index][0]))
3732 {
3733 CompleteDescription = CompleteDescription + TEXT(".") + Description[Index];
3734 }
3735 else
3736 {
3737 CompleteDescription = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s.%s"), *CompleteDescription, *Description[Index]);
3738 }
3739 }
3740
3741 return CompleteDescription;
3742 }
3743
3744 FString GetId() const
3745 {
3746 if (Description.Last().EndsWith(TEXT("]")))
3747 {
3748 FString ItDescription = Description.Last();
3749 ItDescription.RemoveAt(ItDescription.Len() - 1);
3750
3751 int32 StartingBraceIndex = INDEX_NONE;
3752 if (ItDescription.FindLastChar(TEXT('['), StartingBraceIndex) && StartingBraceIndex != ItDescription.Len() - 1)
3753 {
3754 FString CommandId = ItDescription.RightChop(StartingBraceIndex + 1);
3755 return CommandId;
3756 }
3757 }
3758
3759 FString CompleteId;
3760 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Description.Num(); ++Index)
3761 {
3762 if (Description[Index].IsEmpty())
3763 {
3764 continue;
3765 }
3766
3767 if (CompleteId.IsEmpty())
3768 {
3769 CompleteId = Description[Index];
3770 }
3771 else if (FChar::IsWhitespace(CompleteId[CompleteId.Len() - 1]) || FChar::IsWhitespace(Description[Index][0]))
3772 {
3773 CompleteId = CompleteId + Description[Index];
3774 }
3775 else
3776 {
3777 CompleteId = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s %s"), *CompleteId, *Description[Index]);
3778 }
3779 }
3780
3781 return CompleteId;
3782 }
3783
3784private:
3785 TArray<FString> Description;
3786 TMap<FString, TSharedRef<FSpec>> IdToSpecMap;
3787 TSharedPtr<FSpecDefinitionScope> RootDefinitionScope;
3788 TArray<TSharedRef<FSpecDefinitionScope>> DefinitionScopeStack;
3789 bool bHasBeenDefined;
3790};

4122 class TClass : public TBaseClass \
4123 { \
4124 public: \
4125 TClass( const FString& InName ) \

4127 static_assert(!!((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_ApplicationContextMask), "AutomationTest has no application flag. It shouldn't run. See AutomationTest.h."); \
4128 static_assert( !!(((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_FilterMask) == EAutomationTestFlags::SmokeFilter) || \
4129 !!(((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_FilterMask) == EAutomationTestFlags::EngineFilter) || \
4130 !!(((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_FilterMask) == EAutomationTestFlags::ProductFilter) || \
4131 !!(((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_FilterMask) == EAutomationTestFlags::PerfFilter) || \
4132 !!(((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_FilterMask) == EAutomationTestFlags::StressFilter) || \
4133 !!(((TFlags) & EAutomationTestFlags_FilterMask) == EAutomationTestFlags::NegativeFilter), \
4134 "All AutomationTests must have exactly 1 filter type specified. See AutomationTest.h."); \
4135 } \
4136 virtual EAutomationTestFlags GetTestFlags() const override { return TFlags; } \
4137 virtual bool IsStressTest() const { return false; } \
4138 virtual uint32 GetRequiredDeviceNum() const override { return 1; } \
4139 virtual FString GetTestSourceFileName() const override { return FileName; } \
4140 virtual int32 GetTestSourceFileLine() const override { return LineNumber; } \
4141 protected: \
4142 virtual void GetTests(TArray<FString>& OutBeautifiedNames, TArray <FString>& OutTestCommands) const override \
4143 { \
4144 OutBeautifiedNames.Add(PrettyName); \
4145 OutTestCommands.Add(FString()); \
4146 } \
4147 AUTORTFM_DISABLE_IF(!EnumHasAnyFlags(TFlags, EAutomationTestFlags::SupportsAutoRTFM)) \
4148 virtual bool RunTest(const FString& Parameters) override; \
4149 virtual FString GetBeautifiedTestName() const override { return PrettyName; } \
4150 };

4738class FFunctionLatentCommand : public IAutomationLatentCommand
4739{
4740public:
4741 FFunctionLatentCommand(TFunction<bool()> InLatentPredicate)
4742 : LatentPredicate(MoveTemp(InLatentPredicate))
4743 {
4744 }
4745
4746 virtual ~FFunctionLatentCommand() = default;
4747
4748 virtual bool Update() override
4749 {
4750 return LatentPredicate();
4751 }
4752
4753private:
4754 TFunction<bool()> LatentPredicate;
4755};

4757
4758class FDelayedFunctionLatentCommand : public IAutomationLatentCommand
4759{
4760public:
4761 FDelayedFunctionLatentCommand(TFunction<void()> InCallback, float InDelay = 0.1f)
4762 : Callback(MoveTemp(InCallback))
4763 , Delay(InDelay)
4764 {}
4765
4766 virtual bool Update() override
4767 {
4768 double NewTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
4769 if ( NewTime - StartTime >= Delay )
4770 {
4771 Callback();
4772 return true;
4773 }
4774 return false;
4775 }
4776
4777private:
4778 TFunction<void()> Callback;
4779 float Delay;
4780};
4781
4782
4783class FUntilCommand : public IAutomationLatentCommand
4784{
4785public:
4786 FUntilCommand(TFunction<bool()> InCallback, TFunction<bool()> InTimeoutCallback, float InTimeout = 5.0f)
4787 : Callback(MoveTemp(InCallback))
4788 , TimeoutCallback(MoveTemp(InTimeoutCallback))
4789 , Timeout(InTimeout)
4790 {}
4791
4792 FUntilCommand(TFunction<bool()> InCallback, float InTimeout = 5.0f)
4793 : Callback(MoveTemp(InCallback))
4794 , TimeoutCallback([]() { return true; })
4795 , Timeout(InTimeout)
4796 {}
4797
4798 virtual bool Update() override
4799 {
4800 if ( !Callback() )
4801 {
4802 const double NewTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
4803 if ( NewTime - StartTime >= Timeout )
4804 {
4805 TimeoutCallback();
4806 return true;
4807 }
4808
4809 return false;
4810 }
4811
4812 return true;
4813 }
4814
4815private:
4816 TFunction<bool()> Callback;
4817 TFunction<bool()> TimeoutCallback;
4818 float Timeout;
4819};

4821// Extension of IAutomationLatentCommand with delays between attempts
4822// if initial command does not succeed. Has a max retry count that can be
4823// overridden. Default is 10 retries with a 1 second delay in between.
4824// To protect against misuse of unlimited retries, has a Max execution
4825// time of 5 minutes. This can be overridden, but not recommended. Only
4826// do this if you're absolutely certain it will not cause an infinite loop
4827class IAutomationLatentCommandWithRetriesAndDelays : public IAutomationLatentCommand
4828{
4829public:
4830 virtual ~IAutomationLatentCommandWithRetriesAndDelays() = default;
4831
4832 virtual void CommandFailedDueToError(const FString& ErrorMessage)
4833 {
4834 // Stop further commands and log error so the test fails.
4835 FAutomationTestFramework::Get().DequeueAllCommands();
4836 // Must log here so that Gauntlet can also pick up the error for its report. Otherwise, it will only show up in the Automation log.
4837 UE_LOGF(LogLatentCommands, Error, "%ls", *ErrorMessage);
4838 GetCurrentTest()->AddError(ErrorMessage);
4839 }
4840
4841 // Base Update override with delay logic built in. Can be further overridden in child
4842 // classes
4843 virtual bool Update() override
4844 {
4845 if (bHasUnlimitedRetries)
4846 {
4847 // command has unlimited retries, so need to check if max run time has been exceeded
4848 if (HasExceededMaxTotalRunTime())
4849 {
4850 // Command run time has exceeded max total run time.
4851 FString ErrorMessageText = FString::Printf(
4852 TEXT("%s has failed due to exceeding the max allowed run time of %f seconds. ")
4853 TEXT("This may be due to an error, or having a single command attempt to do ")
4854 TEXT("too many things. If this is not due to an error, consider breaking ")
4855 TEXT("up this command into multiple, smaller commands."), *GetTestAndCommandName(), MaxTotalRunTimeInSeconds);
4856 CommandFailedDueToError(ErrorMessageText);
4857 return true;
4858 }
4859 }
4860
4861 if (IsDelayTimerRunning())
4862 {
4863 return false;
4864 }
4865
4866 // pre-increment iteration so that its 1 based instead of 0 based for readability
4867 CurrentIteration++;
4868
4869 if (!CanRetry())
4870 {
4871 // Must log here so that Gauntlet can also pick up the error for its report. Otherwise, it will only show up in the Automation log.
4872 FString ErrorMessageText = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s Latent command with retries and delays has failed after %d retries"), *GetTestAndCommandName(), MaxRetries);
4873 CommandFailedDueToError(ErrorMessageText);
4874 return true;
4875 }
4876
4877 ResetDelayTimer();
4878
4879 // auto-logging for limited retries and unlimited retries
4880 if (bHasUnlimitedRetries)
4881 {
4882 UE_LOGF(LogLatentCommands, Log, "%ls Executing Attempt %d.", *GetTestAndCommandName(), CurrentIteration);
4883 }
4884 else
4885 {
4886 UE_LOGF(LogLatentCommands, Log, "%ls Executing Attempt %d of %d.", *GetTestAndCommandName(), CurrentIteration, MaxRetries);
4887 }
4888
4889 if (Execute())
4890 {
4891 // completion log message, logs total time taken.
4892 UE_LOGF(LogLatentCommands, Log, "%ls Completed Successfully, total run time: %f seconds.", *GetTestAndCommandName(), GetCurrentRunTime());
4893
4894 return true;
4895 }
4896
4897 return false;
4898 }
4899
4900 // Pure virtual method that must be overridden.
4901 // This is the actual command logic.
4902 virtual bool Execute() = 0;
4903
4904private:
4905 // To keep track of which iteration we are on. 1 based
4906 // To allow for more readable logs. Attempt 1 of N instead
4907 // of 0 of N.
4908 int32 CurrentIteration = 0;
4909
4910protected:
4911 // default constructor
4912 IAutomationLatentCommandWithRetriesAndDelays() {}
4913
4914 // parameterized constructor
4915 IAutomationLatentCommandWithRetriesAndDelays(const FString InCommandClassName, const int32 InMaxRetries, const double InWaitTimeBetweenRuns)
4916 :CommandClassName(InCommandClassName)
4917 , MaxRetries(InMaxRetries < 0 ? 0 : InMaxRetries)
4918 , bHasUnlimitedRetries(InMaxRetries == 0)
4919 , DelayTimeInSeconds(InWaitTimeBetweenRuns)
4920 {
4921 // set first run start time so that we don't start off in a delay. Its fine if its negative.
4922 DelayStartTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds() - InWaitTimeBetweenRuns;
4923
4924 // warn if command has unlimited retries MaxTotalRunTime
4925 if (bHasUnlimitedRetries)
4926 {
4927 // Must log here so that Gauntlet can also pick up the error for its report. Otherwise, it will only show up in the Automation log.
4928 UE_LOGF(LogLatentCommands, Warning,
4929 "%ls has been set to Unlimited retries. Will be using MaxTotalRunTime to prevent " "running forever. Default time is set at 300 seconds. If this is not enough time, " "make sure to override this in your Execute() loop.", *GetTestAndCommandName());
4930 }
4931 }
4932
4933 // Resets the Delay Timer by setting start time to now (In game time).
4934 void ResetDelayTimer()
4935 {
4936 DelayStartTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
4937 }
4938
4939 // Determines if timer is running, pausing execution in a non-blocking way.
4940 bool IsDelayTimerRunning() const
4941 {
4942 // time elapsed < Delay time
4943 return (FPlatformTime::Seconds() - DelayStartTime) < DelayTimeInSeconds;
4944 }
4945
4946 // Returns if we have exceeded max allowed total run time for this latent command
4947 bool HasExceededMaxTotalRunTime()
4948 {
4949 return MaxTotalRunTimeInSeconds - GetCurrentRunTime() < 0;
4950 }
4951
4952 // Determines if we should execute the command. If MaxRetries is set to 0,
4953 // indicates unlimited retries.
4954 bool CanRetry() const
4955 {
4956 return (CurrentIteration <= MaxRetries) || MaxRetries == 0;
4957 }
4958
4959 // Returns the command name
4960 FString GetTestAndCommandName() const
4961 {
4962 // Otherwise use the provided string
4963 return FString::Printf(TEXT("Test: %s - Command: %s - "), *GetCurrentTest()->GetTestFullName(), *CommandClassName);
4964 }
4965
4966 FAutomationTestBase* GetCurrentTest() const
4967 {
4968 return FAutomationTestFramework::Get().GetCurrentTest();
4969 }
4970
4971 void OverrideMaxTotalRunTimeInSeconds(double OverrideValue)
4972 {
4973 MaxTotalRunTimeInSeconds = OverrideValue;
4974 }
4975
4976 // Command Name stored for easy logging
4977 const FString CommandClassName = "UnknownCommand";
4978
4979 // Times to retry command before reporting command failure.
4980 // Defaults to 10, but can be overridden.
4981 const int32 MaxRetries = 10;
4982
4983 // Indicates that this latent command has unlimited retries
4984 // Used to implement the MaxTotalRunTimeInSeconds logic
4985 const bool bHasUnlimitedRetries = false;
4986
4987 // Time in between UpdateDelayed calls.
4988 // Default is 1 second but can be overridden.
4989 const double DelayTimeInSeconds = 1.0;
4990
4991 // Time that the Delay Timer started.
4992 double DelayStartTime = 0.0;
4993
4994private:
4995 // Max total run time for command
4996 // Default is 5 minutes, but can be overridden
4997 double MaxTotalRunTimeInSeconds = 300.0;
4998
4999};
